title: Introducing SWE-bench Verified
summary: We’re releasing a human-validated subset of SWE-bench that more reliably evaluates AI models’ ability to solve real-world software issues.
body: We’re releasing a human-validated subset of SWE-bench that more reliably evaluates AI models’ ability to solve real-world software issues.
summaryZh: OpenAI正式发布了SWE-bench Verified，这是一个经过人工验证的子集，旨在更可靠地评估人工智能模型解决现实世界软件问题的能力，减少噪声并提高基准测试的准确性。原始信息显示：We’re releasing a human-validated subset of SWE-bench that more reliably evaluates AI models’ ability to solve real-world software issues.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing SWE-bench Verified”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布了人类验证版的SWE-bench子集，为评估大模型解决真实软件工程问题的能力提供了更可靠的基准。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
